task1.title: Percentage of water used for different purposes in six areas of the world
task1.prompt: The charts below show the percentage of water used for different purposes in six areas of the world.

chartDesc.title: Percentage of water used for different purposes in six areas of the world
chartDesc.overview: Agricultural use is the main proportion of water consumption in Africa, Central Asia, South East Asia, and South America, whereas Industrial use is the highest in North America and Europe. Domestic use accounts for the lowest share in all regions except South America, where industrial use is lowest.
keyFeatures: Agricultural water use is highest in Central Asia (88%), Africa (84%), South East Asia (81%), and South America (71%).
Industrial use accounts for more than half of all water used in Europe (53%) and is the highest sector in North America (48%).
Industrial water use is lowest in Central Asia at 5% and Africa at 7%.
Domestic use is lowest in Central Asia and South East Asia (7% each) and highest in South America (19%).

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
